title: Mini Great Skin Skincare Essentials Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A limited-edition set of three mini Great Skin essentials, including the Double Cleanse Face Wash, Instant Glow Serum, and the NEW Rich Moisturizer.

Skincare Concerns: Dryness, Dullness

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Hyaluronic Acid Complex (Serum): Targets multiple layers of skin to lock in hydration for all-day moisture.
- Oat Lipid Extract (Moisturizer): Reduces the appearance of redness and moisturizes dry and dehydrated skin.
- PHA (Cleanser): Provides gentle exfoliation for visibly brighter and smoother skin.

What Else You Need to Know: This NEW limited-edition set features the complete Great Skin routine in mini sizes—perfect for on-the-go. Designed to work together for enhanced efficacy
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
Great Skin Double Cleanse:
-To remove makeup, shake well, apply two to four pumps onto dry skin, and massage thoroughly for 30–60 seconds.
-Rinse with warm water and pat dry.

Great Skin Instant Glow Serum:
-Shake well and apply one to two pumps onto clean skin.
-Can be applied after your other active serums to lock in hydration and visibly improve texture over time.

Great Skin Rich Moisturizer:
-Apply a dime-size amount to skin.
-Use it as your final step or follow with sunscreen or makeup.
Ingredients+
-Hyaluronic Acid Complex (Serum): Targets multiple layers of skin to lock in hydration for all-day moisture.
-Oat Lipid Extract (Moisturizer): Reduces the appearance of redness and moisturizes dry and dehydrated skin.
-PHA (Cleanser): Provides gentle exfoliation for visibly brighter and smoother skin.

Great Skin Serum:
Water (Aqua/Eau), Propanediol, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Isononyl Isononanoate, Niacinamide, 1,2-Hexanediol, Coptis Japonica Root Extract, Butylene Glycol, Theobroma Cacao (Cocoa) Seed Extract, Citric Acid, Dextrin, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate, Pentylene Glycol, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Ethylhexylglycerin. 26031
